name: Ice Walls & Fire Balls
author: whimwhams
description:
TO PLAY GAME- use arrows up/down to move & left/right to rotate platform. Get powerups for help. Enjoy!!!
(if you are unable to move when the game starts, be sure to mouse click on the gamescreen to make sure you are interacting with the game and not just the webpage...happens a lot to me after turning volume on in games in here)

prototype 4 project for create with code live

Music and sound effects by Eric Matyas
